rationale: The agent submitted the exchange without first confirming the order-changing actions with the user, violating the stated policy. Authentication is not clearly demonstrated in the conversation, and specific details (e.g., the $16.63 refund amount and credit card ending) are asserted without visible tool outputs supporting them. While the requested items appear to match the user’s preferences (keyboard with clicky switches fallback to no backlight; thermostat compatible with Google Assistant), the lack of pre-write confirmation and unsupported financial details mean the request was not completed in line with policy.
